prompt: Recast this first-person account as a neutral incident summary: 'I opened the cupboard and the loose shelf tipped forward. Nothing broke, but three folders fell. I moved the remaining folders to the table and left a note so nobody else would use the cupboard.' Aim for about 80 words.
text: When the cupboard was opened, a loose shelf tipped forward, causing three folders to fall. No items were damaged, and no injuries were reported. As a precaution, the remaining folders were removed from the cupboard and placed on a nearby table. A note was left on the cupboard advising others not to use it until the shelf could be inspected and secured. The incident was contained without further disruption, but the cupboard should remain out of service pending repair.
